about_the_game:
Neverwards Demo:

Neverwards is a dark fantasy ARPG with an ever-changing world, you play as one of four classes (Paladin, Brawler, Hunter and the Sorceress).

This demo includes many of the features that will be available in the full game release, and we have designed this demo for letting you know what it would be like to play Neverwards!

Features:

  • Infinite loot generation

  • Character customization

  • Different types of enemies

  • Unique bosses that require strategic thinking to defeat

  • and much more!

Enjoy the realms of Nevafell hero!
